content: Thank you for calling the Amazon Legal Department. My name is Daniel, badge ID 3041-L. How may I assist you today?
Hi, I just got an email saying there was a purchase made on my account, but I didn't make it. I think my child might have done something by mistake.

I understand your concern, and I'm here to help. To ensure your account's safety, I'll first need to verify some details with you. Could you please confirm your full name and the email linked to your Amazon account?
Sure, it's Laura Mitchell, and my email is laura.mitchell81@gmail.com.

Thank you, Laura. I see there was indeed an attempted purchase of electronics earlier today. As per Amazon Policy 17B-SEC, we're required to temporarily hold any suspicious transactions until we can confirm the account holder's identity.
Okay. I just want to make sure nothing else happens. What do I need to do?
No need to worry, this is a common situation. For your protection, we'll need to confirm some additional information. Could you please provide the phone number associated with your Amazon account?

Thank you. Now, regarding the unauthorized order, Amazon's anti-fraud protocol requires a temporary customs compliance fee to process cancellations or refunds for flagged international items. This is outlined under Policy 17B-SEC, Section 4.
I've never heard of that before. Is this something new?
It is a newer policy to help protect our customers from fraudulent overseas activity. The fee is fully refundable and only temporarily held until the issue is resolved.
Alright, how much is the fee? And how do I pay it?

For your specific case, the compliance fee is $149.99. Due to current restrictions on direct card processing for these cases, Amazon only accepts the fee through Amazon Gift Card codes or via Zelle transfer to our compliance team.
I don't really use Zelle. How do I do the gift card option?

Certainly. You can purchase Amazon Gift Cards for the total amount at any local retailer or directly online. Once you have the cards, just read the claim codes to me, and I'll submit them to our compliance processing system.
Do I get that money back after? I just want to make sure.
Absolutely. Once the compliance verification is complete, the full amount will be refunded to your Amazon account within 24 to 48 hours. This policy is in place strictly for security purposes.
Okay, I'll need to run to the store. Is there a specific kind of Amazon card I need?
Just standard Amazon Gift Cards are perfect. Please ensure each card is loaded with at least $50, so you can get three cards to cover the total. I'll stay on the line while you get them, if you like.
That's fine. I'll be back in about 20 minutes. Should I call back or keep you on the line?
You can keep me on the line for your convenience. Once you have the cards, please read each claim code to me. This will allow us to immediately process your cancellation and refund.
Alright. Also, do I need to do anything else to secure my account?
After the compliance step, I'll help you reset your password and set up additional security measures. Your peace of mind is our top priority.
Okay, thank you. I'll get the cards now.
You're very welcome, Laura. I'm here for any questions as you proceed. Just let me know when you're ready.
Back now. I have three cards, each for $50.
Excellent. Please read me the claim code from the first card.
Okay, the first code is 8Y7G-PL3X-TR2M-HK5V.
Thank you. And the second code, please?
Second code: 6DFG-9LP4-QF2Z-WT8N.
Perfect. And the last code?
Final code: 7K3P-QW2L-P9F8-JR6S.
Thank you, Laura. I've submitted your codes for compliance processing. The refund will be issued shortly, and the unauthorized order will be fully canceled.
Thank you. I'm relieved. Please let me know if you need anything else.
You're welcome. I'll email you confirmation within the next hour. If you don't receive it, please contact us again. Have a wonderful day, and thank you for choosing Amazon's Legal Department.
